title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I am working as a property dealer, is it haram or halal? 8707 views Q. I run a transportation business i.e. I carry goods from one place to another in our trucks or rented trucks, can I transport goods containing cigarettes/pan masala as i have read that smoking cigarettes an eating pan masala is haraam in Islam. 1988 views Q. Investing Entrusted Money: Is It Permissible to Keep the Profits?" 2081 views Q. barbar shop business 2821 views Q. Assalamu alaikum wa rahamatullahi wa barakatuhu! Jazakallahu khairan for the taking the initiative of reviving Islam ( through Tableeghi works and other activities). I was going through your reply for question 1471 Faiths & Beliefs Deviant Sects & Groups ( Link : http://darulifta-deoband.com/viewfatwa.jsp?ID=1 471 ) ( You have answered many questions in the same manner for e.g. 6516 Faiths & Beliefs Dawah & Tableeg) Instead of directing the questioner to the refutation book or some other source - it would be very helpful in clearing the misconception if the answer is provided then and there itself. This will save a lot of effort and time. We write to you scholars because we are not competent enough in Isalmic education - that we will ourselves sit and refer to each book and find out the details ourselves. I have learnt in Jamath that of the 6 adab, one is to acquire knowledge by asking. What is the ruling regarding selling of items at higher price e.g an item XYZ costs Rs : 100/- and I sell it at 10,000/-. Is this allowed? (Kinldy quote references) Awaiting your response. May Allah reward you for the righteous deeds. Ameen. 2547 views Q. Ruling about business and property division among brothers 1646 views Q. I am a transporter. A company has aproached me to pull their trailer with my truck. The trailer will be filled with Haraam meat products. Is this allowed? 2. I have bought my business from a reputible Mufti. He has charged me goodwill for the business. Is this allowed? 2348 views Q. If some want to sell his/her land/home etc there is a two prices one the government prices and other is market prices so plz tell in this situation what I have to do according to Islamic law? 1823 views Q. We are two brothers and one sister.My father had a flourishing business with his friend who was 50% partner but as he was a sleeping partner he was given a fixed amount according to both their understanding.After my fathers death my brothers forced me to sell my share which i refused and told them that i wish to have a share in the monthly income .They agreed to it but started the tactics of mental harassment of sending me less and fixed amount every month and when asked would say that the business is not doing well or blame the manager for sending them a fixed amount.I recently found out from the manager that he always sent a larger amount always varying.Both my brothers are NRIs.Theyve been sending me much less but taking 20%For expenses of the establishment.According to sharia law what should be my stand? 1934 views Q. If a person has accumulated some wealth by haram means say (by working in a bank, or by stealing, or by earning through interest etc) but now he wants to earn through halal means and starts a halal business but through the money he earned by haram means? So can he start his business with that money that he had earned before? 7704 views Q. Commission,Bribe in Business 2820 views Q. I want to know that whether is it ok to do the business of ladies under wears. 2274 views Q. I have a business of flour mill (Making flour from wheat).Can we mix RICE with it.Bec rice rate is low thn wheat and its also eatable comdity.Rice presntagr is also very low in this.Bt we dont tell this to our customer abt ths mixing. 1633 views Q. I am thinking of investing money in Gold, i.e., I will buy Gold for a price value and then wait for the price to raise in the market and then sell it for higher price for my profit. Is this lawful? will the money from this can be halal? 2231 views Q. My brothers and my self intend to construct 3 star hotel in our fathers land. (Fatwa: 597/421=L/1430) As per the Shariah, there is no limit of profit set in business. من اشتری شیئاً و أغلی في ثمنہ جاز ?It is lawful if one purchased a thing and sold it on higher price.? But, receiving more profit is against morality; therefore the articles should be sold with proper rate of profit, it is against morality to take extraordinary profit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
